chunks: Ali, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)
That the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) forbade the grave from being deepened beyond three cubits.

key_terms.يُعَمَّقَ: to be deepened or dug deeper

ai.seo_question: What is the maximum depth for a grave according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the maximum depth of a grave at three cubits, a ruling derived from the Prophet’s practice to balance respect for the deceased with practical considerations of soil stability and ease of access. In Shia jurisprudence, this limit is often discussed alongside the prohibition of excessive mourning or structural extravagance, reflecting the principle of moderation (wasatiyyah) in burial rites.
